class.name: AudioStreamGME
class.brief_description: Plays a game music file (NSF, NSFE, GBS, SPC, VGM, GYM, HES, KSS, SAP or AY) through Game Music Emu.
class.description: Game music files are imported as this stream automatically, with [member format] chosen from the file extension. The stream only holds the file and its metadata. The track to play and looping are set per player through [code]parameters/track_index[/code] and [code]parameters/looping[/code] on an [AudioStreamPlayer]. Each playback instance has its own emulator, so one stream can be played by several players at once.

method.name: get_track_length
method.description: Returns the play length of the given track in seconds. Uses the file's length data when present, otherwise intro plus two loops, otherwise 150 seconds.

method.name: get_track_title
method.description: Returns the title of the given track, or an empty string if the file has none.

method.name: get_track_titles
method.description: Returns the titles of all tracks. Tracks without a title give an empty string.

members.member: The author stored in the file. Read-only.

The raw contents of the music file.
The file format, which selects the emulator.
The game title stored in the file. Read-only.
